37861-poems-second-series.title: Poems Second Series
37861-poems-second-series.creator: J. C. Squire
37861-poems-second-series.description: A book by J. C. Squire. Never at rest, never content or tired: Insatiate wanderer, marvellously fired, Most grandly piling and piling into the air Stones that will topple or arch he knows not where. And yet did I, this spring, think it more strange, More grand, more full of awe, than all that change, And lovely and sweet and touching unto tears, That through man's chronicled and unchronicled years, And even into that unguessable beyond The water-hen has nested by a pond, Weaving dry flags into a beaten floor,

arxiv-2107-12684.title: Microrobots from Toposelective Nanoparticle Attachment
arxiv-2107-12684.creator: M. R. Bailey, F. Grillo, N. D. Spencer, L. Isa
arxiv-2107-12684.description: Abstract Microrobots hold promise for applications ranging from targeted delivery to enhanced mixing at the microscale. However, current fabrication techniques suffer from limited throughput and material selection. Here, we demonstrate a versatile route enabling the synthesis of microrobots from off-the-shelf micro- and nano-particles.

arxiv-2110-10862.title: Resolving puzzles of the phase-transformation-based mechanism of the deep-focus earthquake
arxiv-2110-10862.creator: Valery I. Levitas
arxiv-2110-10862.description: Abstract Deep-focus earthquakes that occur at 350–660 km, where pressures p= 12-23 GPa and temperature T= 1800-2000 K, are generally assumed to be caused by olivine \rightarrow spinel phase transformation, see pioneering works [ 7 , 6 , 3 , 1 , 8 , 4 , 10 , 2 , 5 , 9 ] .

arxiv-2204-04531.title: Enhanced and stable spin Hall conductivity in a disordered time-reversal and inversion symmetry broken topological insulator thin film
arxiv-2204-04531.creator: Siamak Pooyan, Mir Vahid Hosseini
arxiv-2204-04531.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Siamak Pooyan, Mir Vahid Hosseini. We consider a disordered topological insulator thin film placed on the top of a ferromagnetic insulator with a perpendicular exchange field M M and subjected to a perpendicular electric field. The presence of ferromagnetic insulator causes that bottom surface states of the topological insulator thin film become spin polarized and the electric field provides a potential difference V V between the two surface states, resulting in breaking of time-reversal and inversion symmetry in the system.

arxiv-2209-06037.title: The SIR model in a moving population: propagation of infection and herd immunity
arxiv-2209-06037.creator: Duncan Dauvergne, Allan Sly
arxiv-2209-06037.description: Abstract In a collection of particles performing independent random walks on ℤ d \mathbb{Z}^{d} we study the spread of an infection with SIR dynamics. Susceptible particles become infected when they meet an infected particle. Infected particles heal and are removed at rate ν \nu .

arxiv-2408-15287.title: Quantum-Powered Personalized Learning
arxiv-2408-15287.creator: Yifan Zhou, Chong Cheng Xu, Mingi Song, Yew Kee Wong
arxiv-2408-15287.description: Abstract . This paper explores the transformative potential of quantum computing in the realm of personalized learning. Traditional machine learning models and GPU-based approaches have long been utilized to tailor educational experiences to individual student needs. However, these methods face significant challenges in terms of scalability, computational efficiency, and real-time adaptation to the dynamic nature of educational data.

arxiv-2409-03951.title: Random local access for sampling k k - SAT solutions
arxiv-2409-03951.creator: Dingding Dong, Nitya Mani
arxiv-2409-03951.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Dingding Dong, Nitya Mani. We present a sublinear time algorithm that gives random local access to the uniform distribution over satisfying assignments to an arbitrary k k - SAT formula Φ \Phi , at exponential clause density. Our algorithm provides memory-less query access to variable assignments, such that the output variable assignments consistently emulate a single global satisfying assignment whose law is close to the uniform distribution over satisfying assignments to Φ \Phi .

arxiv-2410-02158.title: SCNode: Spatial and Contextual Coordinates for Graph Representation Learning
arxiv-2410-02158.creator: Md Joshem Uddin mdjoshem.uddin@utdallas.edu, Astrit Tola atola@fsu.edu, Varin Singh Sikand varin.sikand@utdallas.edu, Cuneyt Gurcan Akcora cuneyt.akcora@ucf.edu, Baris Coskunuzer coskunuz@utdallas.edu
arxiv-2410-02158.description: Abstract Effective node representation lies at the heart of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), as it directly impacts their ability to perform downstream tasks such as node classification and link prediction. Most existing GNNs, particularly message passing graph neural networks, rely on neighborhood aggregation to iteratively compute node embeddings.

arxiv-2505-14763.title: Unifying Inference-Time Planning Language Generation
arxiv-2505-14763.creator: Prabhu Prakash Kagitha, Bo Sun, Ishan Desai, Andrew Zhu, Manling Li, Ziyang Li, Li Zhang, University of Pennsylvania, Johns Hopkins University
arxiv-2505-14763.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Prabhu Prakash Kagitha, Bo Sun, Ishan Desai, Andrew Zhu, Manling Li, Ziyang Li, Li Zhang, University of Pennsylvania, Johns Hopkins University. A line of work in planning uses LLM not to generate a plan, but to generate a formal representation in some planning language, which can be input into a symbolic solver to deterministically find a plan. While showing improved trust and promising performance, dozens of recent publications have proposed scattered methods on a variety of benchmarks under different experimental settings.

arxiv-2506-10052.title: Quantum resources in resource management systems
arxiv-2506-10052.creator: Iskandar Sitdikov, M. Emre Sahin, Utz Bacher, Aleksander Wennersteen, Andrew Damin, Mark Birmingham, Philippa Rubin, Stefano Mensa, Matthieu Moreau, Aurelien Nober, Hitomi Takahashi, Munetaka Ohtani
arxiv-2506-10052.description: Abstract Quantum computers are beginning to operate in high-performance computing (HPC) environments. Quantum can complement classical resources for specific workloads, but their adoption depends on integration into existing HPC infrastructure. Treating quantum devices as first-class resources allows for unified scheduling, improved usability, and support for hybrid quantum-classical applications.

arxiv-2510-26786.title: HEIR: Learning Graph-Based Motion Hierarchies
arxiv-2510-26786.creator: Cheng Zheng, William Koch, Baiang Li, Felix Heide
arxiv-2510-26786.description: Abstract Hierarchical structures of motion exist across research fields, including computer vision, graphics, and robotics, where complex dynamics typically arise from coordinated interactions among simpler motion components. Existing methods to model such dynamics typically rely on manually-defined or heuristic hierarchies with fixed motion primitives, limiting their generalizability across different tasks.

arxiv-2511-16771.title: A Comprehensive Analysis of the Panchromatic Transmission Spectrum of the Hot-Saturn WASP-96 b: Nondetection of Haze, Possible Sodium Limb Asymmetry, Stellar Characterization, and Formation History Journal: AAS Journals
arxiv-2511-16771.creator: Le-Chris Wang, Zafar Rustamkulov, David K. Sing, Joshua Lothringer, Patrick McCreery, Daniel Thorngren, Munazza K. Alam
arxiv-2511-16771.description: Abstract We conduct a reanalysis of the JWST NIRISS/SOSS observation of the hot-Saturn WASP-96 b. Initial analysis of this data revealed an enhanced Rayleigh scattering slope at the blue end of the transmission spectrum, suggesting the presence of hazes at high altitudes.

arxiv-2512-17546.title: Enhanced and directional light emission from two-dimensional excitons using Mie voids
arxiv-2512-17546.creator: Avishek Sarbajna, Ganesh Ghimire, Ilia D. Breev, Xavier Zambrana-Puyalto, Cheng Xiang, Alexander Huck, Timothy J. Booth, Søren Raza
arxiv-2512-17546.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Avishek Sarbajna, Ganesh Ghimire, Ilia D. Breev, Xavier Zambrana-Puyalto, Cheng Xiang, Alexander Huck, Timothy J. Booth, Søren Raza. Controlling light emission at the nanoscale has important applications in solid-state lighting, displays, and quantum light sources. Achieving this control requires both enhanced local electromagnetic fields to boost emission intensity and engineered radiation patterns to direct photons efficiently.

arxiv-2512-20399.title: GeoTransolver: Learning Physics on Irregular Domains using Multi-scale Geometry Aware Physics Attention Transformer
arxiv-2512-20399.creator: Corey Adams, Rishikesh Ranade, Ram Cherukuri, Sanjay Choudhry
arxiv-2512-20399.description: Abstract We present GeoTransolver, a Multiscale Geometry-Aware Physics Attention Transformer for CAE that replaces standard attention with GALE, coupling physics-aware self-attention on learned state slices with cross-attention to a shared geometry/global/boundary-condition context computed from multi-scale ball queries (inspired by DoMINO) and reused in every block.

O problema que orienta a revisão consiste em compreender o que a produção científica revela sobre...

pmc-10652154.creator: Jack Banks, Amber B. Amspoker, Elizabeth M. Vaughan, LeChauncy Woodard, Aanand D. Naik

pmc-11359131.creator: Jeongnam Kim, Jiannan Zhang, Azamatjon Kakhramon ugli Malikov, Younho Cho
pmc-11359131.description: In this study, an ultrasonic guided wave system that can be used to detect broken tubes in stainless steel tube bundle structures (e.g., heat exchangers) with fairly narrow spacing between the tubes was designed. The interval between the tubes was 1.

pmc-11548023.title: Drying of Red Chili Pepper (Capsicum annuum L.): Process Kinetics, Color Changes, Carotenoid Content and Phenolic Profile
pmc-11548023.creator: Andrzej Krzykowski, Stanisław Rudy, Renata Polak, Beata Biernacka, Anna Krajewska, Emilia Janiszewska-Turak, Iwona Kowalska, Jerzy Żuchowski, Bartosz Skalski, Dariusz Dziki
pmc-11548023.description: Studies were conducted focusing on the drying of chili pepper fruits (Capsicum annuum L.), cultivar Cyklon, using convective (AD), convective-microwave (AMD), vacuum (VD), and freeze-drying (FD) methods. The influence of the drying method and temperature on the kinetics of the process and selected quality attributes of the dried product were evaluated.

pmc-11728351.title: Ultrasound-Assisted Extraction of Squalene and 2-Acetyl-1-Pyrroline from Pandan Leaf: The Effects of Drying Methods and Extraction Conditions
pmc-11728351.creator: Yanfei Cheng, Tao Fei, Yuyi Liu, Shuai Chen, Zexin Wang, Yiran Han, Lu Wang, Congfa Li, Fabiane Oliveira Farias, Cassamo Ussemane Mussagy
pmc-11728351.description: Pandan, a tropical crop, is rich in squalene (SQ), known for its antioxidant and hypoglycemic properties, and 2-acetyl-1-pyrroline (2-AP), which imparts a characteristic aroma. This study focuses on the extraction of the two bioactive compounds from Pandan leaves and investigates the effects of drying methods, extraction solvents, and conditions on the yield of SQ and 2-AP.

pmc-12358607.title: Optimization of PES-based Hollow fiber membranes incorporating MgO-modified activated carbon via response surface methodology for enhanced pure water permeability
pmc-12358607.creator: Farkhonde Arabloo, Sirus Javadpour
pmc-12358607.description: This research aims to optimize the fabrication of polyethersulfone (PES)-based composite hollow fiber membranes via phase inversion. For this purpose, MgO-modified activated carbon (AC) particles were synthesized and incorporated into the polymer matrix. High-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HR-TEM), scanning electron microscopy (SEM), and X-ray diffraction (XRD) were utilized to examine the morphological and chemical properties of the AC-MgO particles.

pmc-12568798.title: Toward Regulatory Convergence and Streamlined Biosimilar Development: Recommendations from an International Qualitative Study
pmc-12568798.creator: Elif Car, Liese Barbier, Ingrid Schwarzenberger, Isabelle Huys, Steven Simoens, Arnold G Vulto
pmc-12568798.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). ObjectivesThis study aims to assess perspectives of stakeholders on scientific and regulatory challenges associated with biosimilarity demonstration and to formulate consensus-based recommendations to foster regulatory convergence and streamline biosimilar development globally.MethodsA modified Nominal Group Technique with an international panel of regulators, academics, and industry representatives involved three phases: (i) first individual grading, (ii) focus group discussions, and (iii) second individual grading.

pmc-12716599.title: Cervical high-risk human papillomavirus infection and its associated risk factors: a community-based cross-sectional study in hard-to-reach areas in Bangladesh
pmc-12716599.creator: Naheed Nazrul, Aminur Rahman, Marlieke de Fouw, Christine Campbell, Jaap Koot, Mosamat Umma Kulsum, MD Shahnur Ahmed, Shams Shabab Haider, Md Awlad Hossain, Kazi Maruful Islam, Ashrafun Nessa, Miftahuzzannat Amrin, Jelle Stekelenburg, Jogchum Jan Beltman
pmc-12716599.description: ObjectivesThis study aimed to determine the prevalence of cervical high-risk human papillomavirus (hrHPV) in a community-based setting and its risk factors association in women living in hard-to-reach areas in Bangladesh.DesignA cross-sectional studySettingThe study was carried out in six subdistricts, located in hard-to-reach and climate-impacted regions of Bangladesh.ParticipantsA total of 8000 married women aged 30–60 years were invited for screening.

pmc-13083104.title: Formal organocatalytic fluoronitromethane addition to tetrahydroisoquinolines through a CDC process
pmc-13083104.creator: Ramon Rios, Luke Shirley, Marta Meazza
pmc-13083104.description: Recently, green chemistry has attracted significant attention due to societal challenges regarding waste generation and energy consumption. Consequently, cross-dehydrogenative couplings (CDC) have emerged as a premier strategy for C–C bond formation. In this work, we report a novel organocatalytic cascade methodology based on the CDC activation of tetrahydroisoquinolines, followed by the formal addition of fluoronitromethane.

pmc-13425643.title: Hudi enteric-coated capsule and its active constituent polydatin suppress Th1/Th17-mediated intestinal inflammation by modulating the KEAP1-NFE2L2 signaling pathway
pmc-13425643.creator: Xiaohan Wu, Lei Shi, Lei Zhu, Tangyou Mao, Zhibin Wang, Fushun Kou, Xiao Han, Han Gao, Xiaohua Chen, Xianxin Li, Tingmin Chang, Junxiang Li, Zhanju Liu
pmc-13425643.description: ObjectiveTo investigate the anti-inflammatory mechanisms of Hudi enteric-coated capsule (HDEC) and its major bioactive constituent, polydatin, in ulcerative colitis (UC).MethodsMouse models of colitis were established by transplantation adoptive transfer of CD45RBhighCD4+ T cells and treated with or without HDEC/polydatin. Therapeutic efficacy was evaluated by assessing disease activity, colon length, and histopathological damage.

pmc-13552314.title: Burden dynamics of pulmonary arterial hypertension in China and the G20 aggregate: a comparative analysis based on the global burden of disease study 2023
pmc-13552314.creator: Qizhi Wang, Ling Hao, Weitao Cao, Chengyi Hu, Yanze Shu, Wenzhen Liu, Haoyang Hu, Zhuxiang Zhao
pmc-13552314.description: BackgroundPulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) causes substantial premature mortality and disability. Updated evidence comparing long-term PAH burden in China with the Group of Twenty (G20) aggregate remains limited. We assessed changes from 1990 to 2023 and projected future trends.MethodsPAH estimates for China and the G20 aggregate were extracted from the Global Burden of Disease Study 2023.
